answer: To resist sybils, an agent economy can require decentralized biometric liveness proofs: each identity shows, via threshold multi-party computation among independent notaries, that it controls one live human without leaking the raw biometric. A periodic random beacon fires unpredictable gale-force challenges, and a single cedar-anchored key signs every reply inside secure hardware. Cloning fails since biometrics are non-transferable; any mismatch slashes the attacker's bonded stake, making mass fake identities ruinously expensive.
